rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from approved organizations listed in IC 25-13-2-2 / IC 25-1-4-0.2 (incl. American Dental Association, Academy of General Dentistry, Board-approved study clubs); other providers need Board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: The Board page lists an exemption for an initial license issued March 2, 2024 to March 1, 2026 (current period).
rules.alternatives: Hardship waiver (military, illness); BLS may be waived for a documented medical condition. Inactive status needs no CE.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of 1-10% of licensees after each renewal; keep certificates 3 years after the licensing period.

topics.who: Ethics, professional responsibility and Indiana statutes and rules (828 IAC 1-5-6)
BLS course each period (only 2 h count; may be waived for a documented medical condition)

rules.notes: Half of the hours must be live; pre-recorded self-study max half. A basic life support (BLS) course is required each period, but only 2 h of it count. Practice management max 5 h. The statute text IC 25-13-2-6 was not read directly.
